tiktok.text:
Harvard is 3rd 👀 Which Ivy League school has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk? Send this to your friend at another Ivy League school.

#yale #columbia #harvard #collegelife #collegefood

UCLA is 5th 👀 Which UC campus has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk? Send this to your friend at another UC.

#ucberkeley #ucdavis #ucirvine #collegelife #collegefood

thread:
Yale edges out Columbia by 9 for the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus.

All 8 Ivy League schools:

1. Yale: 223
2. Columbia: 214
3. Harvard: 156
4. Brown: 133
5. Penn: 125
6. Princeton: 97
7. Cornell: 69
8. Dartmouth: 39

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/rankings/ivy-league/

UC Berkeley has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than UC Davis, UC Irvine and UC San Diego combined.

All 9 UC campuses:

1. UC Berkeley: 277
2. UC Davis: 43
3. UC Irvine: 37
4. UC San Diego: 29
5. UCLA: 14
6. UC Riverside: 12
